basic_details.short_information: IIA Recruitment 2026 OUT! The Indian Institute of Astrophysics (IIA) has released the official notification for the recruitment of 1 Project Associate II post under Advertisement No. IIA/04/2026-27. Candidates holding a Master's or BS-MS degree in Physics/Mathematics, or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology with at least 60% marks from a recognized University/Institution are eligible to apply. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.

Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.

Review all details carefully before submitting the form.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIA Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate-II position at the Indian Institute of Astrophysics is 21st August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's or BS-MS degree in Physics/Mathematics, or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology with at least 60% marks from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-II post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by the Indian Institute of Astrophysics.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 28,000 to Rs. 35,000, plus HRA, depending on their qualifications and NET/GATE status.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selection process may involve a written test, if deemed necessary, followed by an interview. Candidates are advised to prepare for both stages.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job. The position of Project Associate-II is offered on a contractual basis by the Indian Institute of Astrophysics.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Indian Institute of Astrophysics located?
faq.answer: The Indian Institute of Astrophysics is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560034.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Karnataka apply?
faq.answer: The notification specifically mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Karnataka. However, it is advisable to check the detailed notification for any specific state-wise restrictions.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are generally required for the online application?
faq.answer: Typically, you will need to upload your photograph, signature, and relevant educational and experience certificates in the prescribed format. Please refer to the official notification for exact requirements.
